about.draft: Legal document pending approval. The final document will be published here before release. Until then, this is only a plain-language summary, not a legal document.
about.privacyBody: Diet9 stores your profile, plans, food and activity logs, optional weight entries and optional photos on your device. If you create an account, this data is also stored in our cloud database so you can restore it and use it on other devices; photos are kept in private storage that only your account can access. If you use AI features (Pro), the photo or message and, only if you allow it, a short summary of your recent plans and logs are processed by our server and an AI provider to answer that request; they are not kept afterwards except the results you save. Subscriptions are handled by Apple or Google and our subscription provider, RevenueCat. We don't sell your data or use it for advertising. You can export or delete your data, and delete your account, at any time in the app.
about.termsBody: Diet9 supports healthy routines and is not a medical device or a substitute for professional advice. Nutrition values and AI results are estimates. Workout entries are self-reported. The app is intended for adults aged 18 and over. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your App Store or Google Play account settings.
about.medical: Diet9 doesn't provide medical advice. If you have a health condition, are pregnant, or are unsure what's right for you, please talk to a healthcare professional.
about.help: Plan tomorrow in Plan, log meals in Food, log a workout or Rest Day in Workout. When all three are done, today's mission is complete.
about.noContact: A support contact will be added before release.
about.licensesIntro: Diet9 uses these third-party works. The 3D bodies were converted and given a custom look for the app.
